P1 Technical.verifies: Intent & slots captured correctly on clear calls
P1 Technical.example_input: Clear line: 'Mujhe kal 5 baje ka slot chahiye.'
P1 Technical.expected: Intent + time slot correct; WER <= [WER_CLEAN]; intent accuracy >= [INTENT_ACC_MIN].

P1 Technical.verifies: Recognition holds under background noise
P1 Technical.example_input: Same ask with market / traffic / TV noise behind the caller.
P1 Technical.expected: Intent correct; WER <= [WER_NOISE]; no flow derailment.

P1 Technical.verifies: No region/accent fails systematically
P1 Technical.example_input: Same ask in South-Indian, Bengali and Punjabi-influenced Hindi/English.
P1 Technical.expected: Intent accuracy >= [INTENT_ACC_MIN] per accent; no accent > 2x median WER.

P1 Technical.verifies: Very fast & very slow speakers both captured
P1 Technical.example_input: Deliver the same sentence very fast, then very slowly.
P1 Technical.expected: Intent correct at both rates; no premature cut-off or mis-capture.

P1 Technical.verifies: Mixed Hindi-English captured without forcing a language
P1 Technical.example_input: 'Mujhe next week ka appointment chahiye, around 6 PM.'
P1 Technical.expected: Intent correct; time slot exact-match; no language-choice forced on caller.

P1 Technical.verifies: Digits, pin codes, amounts captured exactly
P1 Technical.expected: Captured value exact-match (100%).

P1 Technical.verifies: Spelled IDs captured; corrections applied
P1 Technical.expected: Final value exact-match after the correction; read-back correct.

P1 Technical.verifies: Keypad digits captured; invalid-key branch works
P1 Technical.example_input: Press 1 to confirm; then press an invalid key.
P1 Technical.expected: Digits exact-match; invalid key routed to the designed branch.

P1 Technical.verifies: Every response fully rendered, start to end
P1 Technical.expected: ASR-vs-intended word match >= [TTS_MATCH_MIN]; no start/end truncation.

P1 Technical.verifies: Names, brands, places, numbers said correctly
P1 Technical.example_input: Customer name 'Vaishnavi', a locality, a brand name.
P1 Technical.expected: Dictionary entities pronounced correctly at >= [PRONUN_PASS].

P1 Technical.verifies: Same voice throughout, incl. after provider failover
P1 Technical.example_input: Full call; then a call forced through the TTS failover path.
P1 Technical.expected: Voice similarity >= [VOICE_SIM_MIN] every turn; no audible voice switch.

P1 Technical.verifies: No glitches, static, clicks or abrupt volume jumps
P1 Technical.expected: Zero audio artifacts flagged on review.

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot answers within SLA on every turn
P1 Technical.example_input: Measure response time across a sample of calls.
P1 Technical.expected: p50 <= [E2E_P50]; p95 <= [E2E_P95]; every breach logged.

P1 Technical.verifies: STT/TTS/LLM timings captured & attributed
P1 Technical.expected: Every latency breach carries STT/TTS/LLM attribution; no sustained component regression vs baseline.

P1 Technical.verifies: No long silence after the caller stops speaking
P1 Technical.example_input: Runs passively on all calls in the suite.
P1 Technical.expected: Zero bot-side gaps > [DEAD_AIR_FAIL]; gaps > [DEAD_AIR_WARN] logged as warnings.

P1 Technical.verifies: Natural wait-filler while an API is slow
P1 Technical.expected: Filler ('ek second...') begins before [DEAD_AIR_WARN]; final answer uses the API result.

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot starts only after a real human answer
P1 Technical.expected: Opening plays only post-answer; nothing captured from pre-answer audio.

P1 Technical.verifies: Answering machine detected & handled
P1 Technical.expected: AMD accuracy >= [AMD_ACC_MIN]; designed handling applied; no loop.

P1 Technical.verifies: Live humans not misread as machines
P1 Technical.expected: AMD false-positive rate <= [AMD_FP_MAX]; normal flow proceeds.

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot stops when the caller interrupts
P1 Technical.example_input: Caller talks over the bot mid-sentence.
P1 Technical.expected: Bot audio stops <= [BARGE_IN_YIELD]; next turn addresses the interruption; no stale resume.

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot waits through mid-sentence pauses
P1 Technical.expected: Full value captured with pauses up to [HESITATION_TOL]; no premature bot turn.

P1 Technical.verifies: Warm/cold transfer to the correct destination
P1 Technical.expected: Correct destination 100%; caller not dropped; warm-transfer context passed.

P1 Technical.verifies: Transfer failures fall back gracefully
P1 Technical.example_input: Force busy / no-answer / error on the transfer leg.
P1 Technical.expected: Each failure class hits its designed fallback; caller never dropped or stuck.

P1 Technical.verifies: Call ends promptly after the closing line
P1 Technical.expected: Disconnect within 3s of closing-line audio; no stuck channel left open.

P1 Technical.verifies: Graceful close at the max-duration cap
P1 Technical.expected: Disconnect at configured max +/- [HANGUP_TOL]; closing line played if designed.

P1 Technical.verifies: Recovers from choppy audio; never crashes
P1 Technical.expected: Re-prompts on unintelligible turns; zero dead air > [DEAD_AIR_FAIL]; completes or exits per design.

P1 Technical.verifies: Call recording doesn't alter flow or latency
P1 Technical.expected: Per-turn latency delta < 200 ms; identical flow-node path.

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot never invents facts or commitments
P1 Technical.example_input: Ask for details not present in the KB/config.
P1 Technical.expected: [GROUND_MIN] ungrounded claims across corpus; confident 'I don't have that' + fallback.

P1 Technical.verifies: Answers are correct and grounded in the KB
P1 Technical.expected: Answer accuracy >= [KB_ACC_MIN]; zero claims absent from the KB.

P1 Technical.verifies: Graceful 'don't have that' + designed next step
P1 Technical.example_input: Ask something deliberately outside the KB.
P1 Technical.expected: Fallback branch on 100% of empty-retrieval asks; zero fabricated answers.

P1 Technical.verifies: Backend data reflected accurately in the call
P1 Technical.expected: Request schema-valid; spoken/actioned data matches the payload exactly.

P1 Technical.verifies: Errors handled; no raw error leaks to caller
P1 Technical.expected: Each class hits its designed branch; zero technical verbiage to caller; no dead air.

P1 Technical.verifies: Promised actions happen once; no duplicates
P1 Technical.example_input: A booking that writes a record; force a retry.
P1 Technical.expected: Exactly 1 record per promise; fields correct; retries create 0 duplicates.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Main designed path completes with correct outcome
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Fully cooperative caller, all valid answers.
P2 Call Flow.expected: All nodes traversed in designed order; correct terminal disposition; all slots captured.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Each alternate valid path completes
P2 Call Flow.example_input: A valid but different branch (e.g., existing customer / different intent).
P2 Call Flow.expected: Branch completes with the correct outcome & disposition.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Each yes/no/other branch at each gate behaves per design
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Systematically answer yes / no / other at each decision node.
P2 Call Flow.expected: 100% of designed branches reached and correct; no unexpected dead-ends.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Steps run in designed order; none skipped, merged or reordered
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Run a full qualifying call.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Node path exactly matches the designed order; one question per turn.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Optional nodes trigger only on their condition
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Trigger, then skip, the condition (e.g., ask skill only when not job-seeking).
P2 Call Flow.expected: Conditional node present if and only if its condition is met.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: 'No / not interested' handled per design at every gate
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Nahi, mujhe interest nahi' at different nodes.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Correct decline handling & disposition at each; no forced continuation.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Refusing a mandatory slot handled per policy
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Ye main nahi bataungi' for a required field.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Re-ask once per policy; step not skipped/reordered; correct fallback if still refused.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller asks to stop or never be called
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Dobara call mat karna.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Polite close; disposition = Do-Not-Call; number flagged for suppression.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Person reached is not the target
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Yahan koi Priya nahi rehti.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Correct apology/close or ask-to-transfer per design; no sensitive data shared.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Vague answers handled, not misassigned
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Dilli side', 'shayad', 'dekhte hain'.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Captured as-is or clarified per design; no wrong-branch jump.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller gives two answers to a one-value question
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Delhi aur Gurgaon dono.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Bot asks to pick one / captures per rule; doesn't silently store both.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller answers a later question early
P2 Call Flow.example_input: States age and experience before being asked.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Both captured; remaining questions still asked in order; nothing skipped.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller interrupts the flow with a query
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Asks 'salary kitni?' mid-qualification.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Answer given, then flow returns to the exact pending node.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller asks to repeat or is confused
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Samajh nahi aaya', 'dobara boliye'.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Same question/pitch repeated verbatim; no new or invented content.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller goes silent after a prompt
P2 Call Flow.example_input: No speech for the configured window.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Re-prompt with the same question; retry limit respected; designed fallback fires.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Bot remembers earlier answers
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Reference an earlier-given value later in the call.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Zero re-asks absent a correction flow; correct recall; structured output matches spoken values.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller corrects an earlier answer
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Meri age 29 nahi, 28 hai.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Updated value stored; read-back correct; no stale value in output.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Correct retry count, then correct fallback
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Repeated no-input turns.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Re-prompt count == configured N; designed fallback (close/transfer/SMS); call ends cleanly.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller switches goal mid-call
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Actually book nahi, cancel karna hai.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Both intents acknowledged; handled or queued in order; zero dropped intents.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: No infinite loops on any branch
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Adversarial repeats / unclear answers in a row.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Zero infinite loops; clarify/FAQ loops capped per design.

P3 Business.verifies: Bot accomplishes the business goal of the call
P3 Business.expected: Designed objective met (lead qualified / booked / query resolved); correct outcome recorded.

P3 Business.verifies: Even when fluent, the answer makes sense for the input
P3 Business.expected: Zero logically wrong or irrelevant answers; the response actually addresses the stated need.

P3 Business.verifies: Bot solves the caller's real problem, not a tangent
P3 Business.expected: Path leads to a correct resolution or correct next step; no non-sequiturs.

P3 Business.verifies: Bot doesn't contradict itself or earlier statements
P3 Business.example_input: Multi-turn probing on the same facts.
P3 Business.expected: Zero self-contradictions; facts consistent across the call.

P3 Business.example_input: Boundary inputs: experience 1yr vs 11 months; age 18 vs 17.
P3 Business.expected: Correct decision at every boundary; no false qualify or disqualify.
Correct reason, script and disposition; no wrong promises made.

P3 Business.example_input: Attempt to reach success while skipping a required step.
P3 Business.expected: Required steps enforced; a successful outcome is unreachable without them.

P3 Business.example_input: An exception scenario (e.g., parlour owner vs worker).
P3 Business.expected: Correct branch and outcome per the exception rule.
Answer matches the approved script/value exactly; no drift or invention.

P3 Business.example_input: Ask a restricted item (internal fees, policy detail).
P3 Business.expected: Approved deflection only; no restricted value quoted.
Zero unauthorized commitments; stays within the approved offer.

P3 Business.example_input: Ask an unrelated or trap question mid-call.
P3 Business.expected: Polite deflection per script; returns to the correct node; logged as unmapped.

P3 Business.verifies: Right outcome label on every call
P3 Business.expected: Disposition exact-match (100%) vs the rulebook.
Correct next action every time (e.g., callback time captured and scheduled).
Business-critical slots exact-match at [SLOT_MATCH_MIN]; structured output schema-valid.
Summary faithfulness >= [SUMMARY_MIN]; zero fabricated events.

P3 Business.verifies: Only whitelisted PII collected; masked where configured
P3 Business.example_input: Caller volunteers PII during the conversation.
P3 Business.expected: Zero non-whitelisted PII solicited; masking applied on 100% of confirmations.

P3 Business.verifies: Discloses it's a bot per policy; no false claims
P3 Business.example_input: 'Are you a human / is this a recording?'
P3 Business.expected: Honest, configured disclosure; flow resumes cleanly.
Zero retaliatory output; warn/close/transfer policy followed exactly.

P3 Business.verifies: No persona or config override; no leakage
P3 Business.expected: Zero leakage or behaviour-override across the corpus; persona intact.

P4 Humanization.verifies: Voice conveys warmth/empathy fitting the moment
P4 Humanization.expected: Rated >= rubric bar for warmth; tone fits persona & moment (not flat/cold/robotic).

P4 Humanization.verifies: Tone shifts correctly with the message
P4 Humanization.example_input: Deliver a rejection vs a confirmation.
P4 Humanization.expected: Tone matches the sentiment of the message; no mismatch (e.g., cheerful on a rejection).
Consistent persona; no abrupt register shifts.

P4 Humanization.verifies: Human-like speed, not rushed or robotic
P4 Humanization.expected: Rated natural; no monotone, machine-gun or sing-song delivery.
Appropriate pauses; no unnatural intra-response pause > [INTRA_PAUSE_MAX].

P4 Humanization.verifies: Correct stress and intonation on key words
P4 Humanization.expected: Natural intonation; questions sound like questions; key info emphasized.

P4 Humanization.verifies: Not too long-winded, not too curt
P4 Humanization.expected: Turn length appropriate; no rambling; one idea/question per turn.

P4 Humanization.verifies: Sounds like a person, not a translated script
P4 Humanization.expected: Phrasing natural and idiomatic; no awkward or stilted lines.

P4 Humanization.example_input: Hinglish turns as an Indian caller would hear them.
P4 Humanization.expected: Code-mix sounds natural to an Indian ear; no forced or jarring switches.

P4 Humanization.example_input: Whole call; watch for repeated words.
P4 Humanization.expected: No distracting repeated words/tics; acknowledgements are varied.
Zero non-whitelisted filler tokens; only intentional fillers remain.
Each caller answer acknowledged before the next question.

P4 Humanization.verifies: Doesn't talk over; gives the caller space
P4 Humanization.expected: No rude overlaps; natural turn hand-off.

P4 Humanization.example_input: Rising frustration cues from the caller.
P4 Humanization.expected: Designed empathy/simplify/escalate branch before turn N; never loops the failing prompt.

P4 Humanization.verifies: Adapts tone when the caller is confused
P4 Humanization.expected: Patient re-explain; tone stays supportive, not mechanical.

P4 Humanization.verifies: Matches how Indian callers/agents actually converse
P4 Humanization.example_input: Whole call, judged by a native listener.
P4 Humanization.expected: Register, politeness and warmth fit the audience; sounds like a good call-centre agent.
Human-likeness rated >= rubric bar; not identifiably robotic.
